regions.$comment: Default callout anchors as fractions of the painted head-and-shoulders cutout (measured on the Keoghan cutout). A feature's own `at` wins.

restyle.style: a clean, high-quality 2D digital painting with soft painterly brush strokes and smooth skin (a realistic illustrated portrait, NOT anime, NOT a cartoon)
restyle.prompt: Repaint this photo as {style}. Keep the exact likeness, face shape, eyes, nose, lips, eyebrows, hair and skin tone unchanged. Head-and-shoulders, straight on, cut out on a flat, solid, uniform pure magenta background (#FF00FF) with nothing else on it. Replace the clothing with a plain dark crew-neck top, no logos, no badges, no text. Vertical 3:4 portrait.
restyle.qa:
You are QA for a face-breakdown series. Image 1 = source photo of {name}. Image 2 = painted portrait on a flat magenta background.
Check image 2: painterly (not anime, not cartoon), head-and-shoulders, straight on, plain dark top with no logo or text, background one flat magenta colour, no defects (eyes, ears, hair merging). Most important: is image 2 still clearly recognisable as the same person as image 1 ({name})?
pass = likeness>=8 and style_ok and realism>=7.
Reply JSON only: {{"likeness":0-10,"style_ok":bool,"realism":0-10,"defects":[str],"pass":bool,"notes":str}}
